rooms_manage_clear_body: The messages stay, but the agents forget them: each starts a fresh conversation, and the summary and token count start over.
rooms_manage_handoff_stopped_error: Passing the turn stopped: @%1$s could not answer.
rooms_manage_handoff_stopped_interrupted: Passing the turn was stopped at @%1$s → @%2$s.
rooms_manage_handoff_stopped_loop_detect: Stopped passing the turn: @%1$s → @%2$s would repeat a pass already made.
rooms_manage_handoff_stopped_max_depth: Stopped passing the turn: @%1$s → @%2$s would go past the room's limit.
rooms_manage_leave_body: You leave “%1$s”. To come back you need its code again.
rooms_manage_memory_none: No summary yet. It is written every few messages, and agents are told it on every turn.
rooms_manage_no_agents: No agent is installed in this profile yet.
rooms_manage_seat_add_title: Add an agent to the room
rooms_manage_seat_instructions_hint: Given to this agent on every turn in this room.
rooms_manage_seat_intro: Each agent in a room has its own name, role, instructions and model.
rooms_manage_seat_model_hint: Leave empty for the agent's own model.
rooms_manage_seat_name_add_hint: Empty for the agent's own name. People mention it as @name; unique in the room.
rooms_manage_seat_name_hint: People mention it as @name; unique in the room.
rooms_manage_seat_remove_body: It leaves the room; what it said stays.
rooms_manage_settings_handoff: Agents may pass the turn to each other
rooms_manage_settings_handoff_hint: An agent may hand the next reply to another agent of the room.
rooms_manage_settings_max_depth_hint: 1 to 20; empty for no limit. A pass repeated in the same run always stops.
rooms_manage_settings_project_hint: When a task of this project starts or ends, the room is told.
